envenomation resulting in negative regulation of high voltage-gated calcium channel activity in other organism

definition: A process in which an organism inhibits or disrupts the activity of a high voltage-gated calcium channel in another organism via the action of a venom.
label: venom-mediated inhibition of high voltage-gated calcium channel activity
